descriptionHtml:
**ANTEC A30 NEO CPU FAN**



**Brand:** ANTEC


**Model:** A30 NEO


**Type:** Air CPU Cooler


**Compatibility:** Intel & AMD Sockets



---



**Dimensions & Weight:**


- **Heatsink Dimensions:** 104 x 72 x 133 mm (W x D x H)


- **Fan Dimensions:** 92 x 92 x 25 mm


- **Weight:** 380 grams



---



**Fan Specifications:**


- **Fan Speed:** 800 - 2800 RPM (±10%)


- **Airflow:** Up to 35.5 CFM


- **Static Pressure:** Up to 2.0 mmH₂O


- **Noise Level:** < 30 dBA


- **Bearing Type:** Hydraulic bearing


- **Fan Connector:** 4-pin PWM



---



**Heatsink Specifications:**


- **Material:** Aluminum fins


- **Heat Pipes:** 2 x Ø6 mm U-shaped direct contact heat pipes


- **Base Material:** Copper (Direct Contact Technology)



---



**Compatibility (Sockets):**



| Brand | Compatible Sockets |


| :--- | :--- |


| **Intel** | LGA  1851 1700, LGA 1200, LGA 115X (1150, 1151, 1155, 1156) |


| **AMD** | AM5, AM4, AM3+, AM3, AM2+, AM2, FM2+, FM2, FM1 |



---



**Features:**


- Direct contact heat pipes for better heat transfer


- 2 copper heat pipes (Ø6mm)


- PWM fan for automatic speed control


- Hydraulic bearing for quiet operation


- Compact design fits most mid-tower cases


- Easy installation with push-pin system



---



**Package Includes:**


- ANTEC A30 NEO CPU Cooler


- Thermal paste (pre-applied on base)


- Mounting kit for Intel & AMD sockets


- User manual



---



**TDP Support:** Up to 95W



---



**Notes:**


- Suitable for entry-level and mid-range CPUs (Intel Core i3/i5, AMD Ryzen 3/5)


- Not recommended for overclocking or high-end CPUs (i7/i9/Ryzen 7/9)


- Check case CPU cooler clearance before purchase (min 135mm height recommended)



-
